proposals.current: A canvas note that contains text
proposals.proposed: A text box that places a free-form text note on the project canvas, sized and styled by you.

proposals.current: Forwards any incoming data set unchanged to the matching tunnel exit, producing no output at this node.
proposals.proposed: The tunnel entrance takes any incoming data set and forwards it unchanged to the matching tunnel exit, producing no output at this node.

proposals.current: Outputs the data sent through the matching tunnel as a collection of data items, taking no direct input and passing it unchanged.
proposals.proposed: The tunnel exit outputs the data sent through the matching tunnel entrance as a collection of data items, taking no direct input and passing it unchanged.

proposals.current: Marks the entry point of a grouped set of analysis steps. It takes no specific data type and produces no separate result; it simply lets the data you connect to the group enter unchanged for the steps inside to use.
proposals.proposed: The group input is the entry point of a grouped set of analysis steps. It takes no specific data type and produces no separate result; it simply lets the data you connect to the group enter unchanged for the steps inside to use.

proposals.current: It makes the final result of a node group available to the rest of the workflow. It takes that result from the grouped steps and passes it on without changing it.
proposals.proposed: The group output makes the final result of a node group available to the rest of the workflow. It takes that result from the grouped steps and passes it on without changing it.

proposals.current: Converts each provided path into path data.
proposals.proposed: Provides a list of file or folder paths as a path list and converts each provided path into path data.

proposals.current: Provide multiple parameter sets via the inputs to calculate all parameter combinations.
proposals.proposed: Multiply the parameter sets from all inputs to produce every parameter combination. Provide multiple parameter sets via the inputs to calculate all parameter combinations.
